title: MIGONet: a multiple-input graph neural operator with solver-free discrete manufactured-solution training
abstract: arXiv:2611.05876v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Surrogate modeling of transport requires operators that capture the combined influence of spatially distributed sources and Dirichlet and Neumann boundary conditions, together with training datasets that can be generated at low computational cost. This work presents MIGONet, a multiple-input graph neural operator, and a discrete method of manufactured solutions (MMS) that trains it without solving a partial differential equation, using steady heat conduction as the model problem. In the discrete MMS procedure, temperature fields are prescribed a priori, and the source terms and Dirichlet or Neumann boundary data are evaluated with the same discrete operators as the reference finite-difference method (FDM), so every training sample satisfies the discrete governing equations by construction. translated_title: MIGONet：一种采用无求解器离散制造解训练的多输入图神经算子
translated_abstract: 输运问题的代理建模需要能够捕获空间分布源项以及狄利克雷和诺伊曼边界条件共同影响的算子，同时需要能够以较低计算成本生成的训练数据集。本工作提出了MIGONet——一种多输入图神经算子，以及一种离散制造解方法（MMS），该方法以稳态热传导为模型问题，无需求解偏微分方程即可完成训练。在离散MMS过程中，温度场被先验地给定，源项和狄利克雷或诺伊曼边界数据则使用与参考有限差分方法（FDM）相同的离散算子进行评估，因此每个训练样本在构造上都满足离散控制方程。由于边界数据是从每个场中导出的，因此可以为每个样本的每个边界段分配狄利克雷或诺伊曼条件，并且……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种多输入图神经算子MIGONet，结合无需求解偏微分方程的离散制造解训练方法，能够捕获空间分布源项与狄利克雷/诺伊曼边界条件的联合影响，同时大幅降低训练数据生成成本。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MIGONet, a multiple-input graph neural operator trained via a solver-free discrete manufactured-solution method, which captures the combined influence of spatially distributed sources and Dirichlet/Neumann boundary conditions while enabling low-cost training data generation.
